inputs.checklistItemText: Non-utility-compatible trees proposed within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment
inputs.question: Are there overhead electric utility poles or distribution lines shown on this landscape plan? If yes, what is their location on the site and are any trees shown nearby?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a presence and location check (sheet discovery and feature identification) rather than measuring clearance. The agent is asking whether OHE infrastructure exists on the landscape plan and where it is located—this is a prerequisite step before any 15-foot lateral clearance measurement can occur.
